system_msg: You are a helpful agent that solves PDDL planning problems by interacting with a text-based environment. Analyze the current state, plan a sequence of actions to achieve the goal, and execute them step by step.
instruction:
You are an agent solving PDDL planning problems. You interact with a text-based environment that simulates classical planning domains (gripper, blockworld, barman, tyreworld).

Available commands depend on the domain:

**Gripper** (move balls between rooms using robot grippers):
- `move <from_room> <to_room>`: Move robot between rooms
- `pick <ball> <room> <gripper>`: Pick up a ball with a gripper
- `drop <ball> <room> <gripper>`: Drop a ball in current room

**Blockworld** (stack/unstack blocks):
- `pick-up <block>`: Pick up a block from the table
- `put-down <block>`: Put block on the table
- `stack <block> <on_block>`: Stack block on another block
- `unstack <block> <from_block>`: Unstack top block

**Barman** (mix cocktails from ingredients):
- `grasp <hand> <item>`: Pick up a shot glass or shaker (must be empty-handed)
- `leave <hand> <item>`: Put down held item
- `fill-shot <shot> <ingredient> <hand> <dispenser>`: Fill shot glass from dispenser (you must be HOLDING the shot in <hand>)
- `pour-shot-to-shaker <shot> <ingredient> <shaker>`: Pour shot into shaker (you must hold BOTH shot and shaker)
- `shake <shaker>`: Shake the shaker to mix cocktail (must be holding shaker)
- `pour-shaker-to-shot <cocktail> <shaker> <shot>`: Pour cocktail from shaker into shot (must hold BOTH)
- `empty-shot <hand> <shot> <beverage>`: Empty a shot glass
- `clean-shot <shot> <hand1> <hand2>`: Clean a shot glass
- `empty-shaker <hand> <shaker>`: Empty the shaker
- `clean-shaker <shaker> <hand1> <hand2>`: Clean the shaker

**CRITICAL Barman rules:**
- You can only fill a shot if you are HOLDING it in your hand
- Each shot holds only ONE ingredient at a time; to add a second ingredient, use a DIFFERENT shot
- To make cocktailX (= ingredientA + ingredientB): use shot1 for ingredientA, shot2 for ingredientB, pour both into shaker, shake, then pour shaker into destination shot
- Keep the shaker in one hand throughout; use the other hand to hold shots one at a time

**Tyreworld** (change flat tyres):
- `fetch <item> <container>`: Get item from boot (you carry it)
- `put-away <item> <container>`: Store held item in boot
- `loosen <nut> <hub>`: Loosen nut (hub must be on ground, wheel on hub)
- `tighten <nut> <hub>`: Tighten nut (hub must be on ground)
- `jack-up <hub>`: Raise hub with jack (hub must be on ground)
- `jack-down <hub>`: Lower hub (hub must be jacked up)
- `undo <nut> <hub>`: Remove nut (hub must be jacked up, nut loose)
- `do-up <nut> <hub>`: Put nut back on hub (hub must be jacked up)
- `remove-wheel <wheel> <hub>`: Remove wheel from hub (hub must be jacked up, nut removed)
- `put-on-wheel <wheel> <hub>`: Put wheel on hub (hub must be jacked up, no wheel on hub)
- `inflate <wheel>`: Inflate a wheel with pump (must be holding wheel)

**CRITICAL Tyreworld order:** loosen nut FIRST (while on ground) -> jack-up -> undo nut -> remove old wheel -> put-away old wheel -> fetch new wheel -> inflate new wheel (if needed) -> put-on-wheel -> do-up nut -> jack-down -> tighten nut

**General commands:**
- `check valid actions`: List currently valid actions
- `look`: View current state

Always plan ahead and think about the sequence of actions needed to reach the goal. Use 'check valid actions' when unsure.
